parameters.name: Base64
parameters.description: Specifies whether to Base64-decode the value. If you set the base64 parameter to true when you called the [PutKv](~~2850482~~) operation, set this parameter to true to read the original content.

parameters.name: Key
parameters.description: The name of the key to query.

parameters.name: Namespace
parameters.description: The name specified when you call the [CreateKvNamespace](~~2850317~~) operation.
